text:
Maria: Heads up — canary 8523 (v3.12.0) showing a 20-30% tail latency increase on 8k-seq jobs. KV miss rate jumped ~3x after the kernel selection heuristics change.
Jon: Oof. Which merge? the kernel-selection heuristics PR or the batching tweak?
Maria: Kernel-selector PR (8523) landed, but a small batching heuristic tweak (8539) was merged in the same window. Logs show more cold KV reads.
Lee: I pulled a quick profile. Hotspots point at extra memcpy + fallback path in kernel shim when seq len > 4096.
Sasha: Can you paste the perf flame/top lines?
Lee: sure:
```
flame: runtime_kernel_shim::dispatch -> memcpy -> kv_fetch -> redis_call
kv_fetch: 3.1x more calls per request vs baseline
```
Jon: CI perf tests also flagged this but flaked; it didn't block the merge. @ci-bot can you confirm which test regressed?
ci-bot: perf-suite/seq-8k-tail latency increased by 28% in build 3.12.0-rc2 vs baseline.
Maria: That's the one. Canary is at 12% rollout. I recommend pausing the canary and bisecting between 8523 and 8539 to isolate.
Jon: Agreed. Pausing now. @deploy-bot please pause canary 8523 reason="tail-latency-regress"
deploy-bot: Executing: pause-canary 8523
deploy-bot: Canary 8523 paused at 12% rollout. Notifying #rollout-channel.
Sasha: While paused, run a traffic-shaped A/B with pinned kernel variants: compare old selector vs new selector with identical batching.
Lee: I'll run a sampled-traffic A/B and collect KV hit/miss histograms and hotpath profiles. ETA ~45m.
Jon: Also add a temporary canary gate: auto-rollback if p95 tail increases >15% over a 5m window. Config:
```
canary_gate:
  monitor: tail_latency_p95
  window_s: 300
  rollback_threshold_pct: 15
  actions: [pause, rollback]
```
Maria: Good guardrail. Ops/infra: please wire into the canary controller as emergency rule.
Jon: I'm opening a quick PR to add the emergency rule and a synthetic perf check to CI so future merges fail faster.
ci-bot: perf-suite: synthetic-check added on branch perf/fast-check
Sasha: If bisect implicates kernel-selector, we should revert that and land batching tweak separately.
Lee: Bisect results: reverting 8523 returns metrics to baseline; reverting 8539 doesn't help.
Sasha: Strong signal. Proceed with revert 8523 and then re-run canary with batching-only change.
Maria: Revert and ramp plan: revert 8523, resume canary to 10%, monitor for 10m before promoting.
Jon: Creating revert PR for 8523 now.
deploy-bot: Revert PR created: revert-8523. Waiting for approvals and CI.
Maria: Nice fast triage. Leaving this thread for follow-ups and postmortem notes. Add an incident doc if customers were impacted.
